verdict.rationale: Data export applies to CrewAI, especially its managed AMP platform, but the evidence pack documents no feature for exporting user data in open formats. YAML-based agent configuration that can be version-controlled and the open-source nature of the framework are related but different properties, not a documented export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
